changelog.change: v2.1: dataset renamed funding -> financials; added FY2025 revenue, monthly revenue, users, subscribers, March round; every metric has source URL, grade, value_type; removed unsourced 'IPO in 2027'; added SoftBank commitment and stake; derived run-rate multiple and step-up.

Added directly checked OpenAI advertising annualized revenue run-rate and Bloomberg-reported company annualized revenue lower bound. Kept quarterly/FY revenue separate from run rates; did not infer July measurement date from the August report. Requested quarterly revenue, enterprise mix, margin, inference-cost forecasts and cumulative FCF forecast omitted where original-source wording could not be verified; gaps detailed in PR. Existing historical metrics and derived March-basis multiples unchanged and not re-audited.

Upgraded March committed capital ($122B) and post-money valuation ($852B) from secondary Quartz reporting to the directly checked OpenAI announcement, aligning financials with the IPO card. Values and IDs unchanged; committed capital is not cash received. Compute commitment total, latest cash balance and IPO target valuation remain omitted: accessible original wording was not verified in this review; research limitations detailed in PR.

New round: about $1.25T pre-money (CFO on record), $11B first close 2026-11-06, about $15B raised by 2026-11-12, replacing the $30B+/$1.4T target. Run-rate about $50B (end of September), ChatGPT about 1.2B weekly users. Primary counterparty data from Microsoft's and Amazon's 10-Qs (MSFT ~24% as-converted; $10.0B MSFT revenue from OpenAI in Q3; Amazon $50.0B Series C) and SoftBank's Q2 FY2026 report ($99.6B fair value). Older figures kept and marked superseded. No public OpenAI S-1 on EDGAR as of 2026-11-18.
